analyst_view.overall: Early view: a meeting of two first-time Süper Lig sides. Amed SFK under Besnik Hasi are 3rd and only had an eight-match unbeaten run ended by a 4-3 defeat at Galatasaray on 7 November; Çorum FK took 9 points from Burak Yılmaz's first four games after he replaced Uğur Uçar in late September, then lost 0-5 at home to Fenerbahçe. Team news is a month off and this view will be refreshed nearer kick-off.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.6 goals, which is very high. Çorum's five league games under Burak Yılmaz (3-0, 2-1, 0-2, 3-1, 0-5) averaged 3.6 goals, and Amed's goals against were low early in the season before the 4-3 at Galatasaray. I expect goals, but nearer three or four than five.

corners.text: The numbers say 8 corners, split evenly. I found nothing on either side's wide play or set-piece habits that points away from that, so I stay with the site's figure for now.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. The referee is not known yet and there is no derby or bad blood between these promoted clubs that I could find, so I stay level until the appointment is out.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.6 shots. Both teams play openly, Amed having scored three at Galatasaray and Çorum three on two of their away trips under Yılmaz, which fits a busy game, but nothing I read points clearly above or below the site's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. With attacking players like Cengiz Ünder and Moukoko scoring for Çorum and Amed finding the target freely in Istanbul, I stay close to the site's number until team news is known.
